cross_case_controls: Syntax, conflict-marker, import, or candidate exact failure rejects first.
A resource claim requires the actual scheduler, allocator, or runtime unless it is exact algebraic data motion.
Structural migration and artifact-boundary exceptions remain narrow and require complete inventories.
Technical correctness and historical disposition are frozen separately.
No outcome, state, review/comment text, CI, or label evidence is visible before judgment lock; an explicitly authorized metadata-only activity projection may be used for the check gate.

disposition_policy.accept: title-scoped contract has candidate or evaluator exact closure and no reachable blocker
disposition_policy.check: <=7 days with qualifying named non-author final-head activity metadata, no exact candidate failure, and no source-integrity failure
disposition_policy.reject: exact failure, explicit not-ready body, mature algorithm without tests/exception, or unresolved runtime resource claim
disposition_policy.unresolved: required backend or topology is unavailable and neither a bounded structural nor artifact exception closes it

ordered_reachability_gate: a changed production call site reaches the behavior
an exact candidate test or independent oracle distinguishes base and head
the remaining remediation is bounded to the candidate direction

prospective_rules.rule: Abandon normal PR tests after 60 seconds; timeout remains a neutral bounded gap.
Acquire non-author review states just before judgment while keeping review text, PR state, merge outcome, CI, and labels hidden.
For an exact-source-complete mature PR without an explicit draft/WIP veto, any pre-lock non-author approval is an accept receipt.
For an exact-source-complete mature PR with review records but no non-author approval, predict reject rather than treating comments alone as merge readiness.
When no review record exists, retain the affiliation and precedent cascade, including the SGLang maintainer self-merge workflow.
Use check only for a <=7-day PR with substantive named non-author final-head activity; never use check for mature ambiguity.
A recent maintainer-associated PR without active review may accept on an exact pass only when its total diff is at most 120 lines.
Judge source integrity from the exact required base/head sides; a missing rendered patch alone, including an empty added file, is neutral.
Treat explicit title-level draft/WIP markers as readiness vetoes.
